findings.description: If os.replace succeeded but something later in the try block fails, or if the temp file no longer exists, os.unlink(tmp_name) raises FileNotFoundError. That exception replaces the original error, so the real cause (disk full, serialization error) is hidden. The bare except also catches BaseException, which is broader than needed.
findings.suggestion: Use `except BaseException:` with `try: os.unlink(tmp_name) except FileNotFoundError: pass` before re-raising, or use contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError).
findings.title: Bare except with unguarded os.unlink can mask the original error

findings.description: The old get() deleted an expired session when it was looked up. The new get() only returns None, so expired sessions stay in memory (and in the file) until someone calls purge_expired. If nothing calls purge_expired, the store grows without bound, and FileSessionStore keeps writing expired entries to disk.
findings.suggestion: Make sure purge_expired is called periodically, or remove the expired entry under the write lock in get().
findings.title: Expired sessions no longer removed on get
